slides.text:
4 reasons why you won't
reach your goal body

1 — You start over
every Monday

Restarting isn't progress

2 — You eat back
your workouts

The math doesn't care

3 — You treat sleep
as optional

Your body doesn't

slides.heading: 4 — You have no feedback
slides.body: SOMA turns your watch data into answers — what worked, what didn't, what to do next
